draft.shortGloss: to be missed; to come to mind
notes: Note that the subject of the sentence in English is the object being missed in Hindi. You say 'Mujhe tumhari yaad aati hai' (To me, your memory comes), literally meaning 'I miss you'.
Do not confuse this with 'yaad karna', which means to consciously remember, memorize, or call someone to mind.
